=== movep, the one 68000 instruction the table encodes
 movepw %d0,0(%a0)
 movepl %d1,8(%a1)
 movepw -2(%a2),%d2
 movepl 0x7ff0(%a3),%d3
=== a 68000 DBcc beyond reach becomes dbcc, bra.s and jmp
 dbra %d0,far
 dbeq %d1,near
near: nop
 .space 40000
far: rts
=== a 68000 DBcc to an undefined symbol
 dbra %d0,ext
=== a 68000 jra beyond reach becomes jmp
 jra far
 jbne far
 jbsr far
 .space 40000
far: rts
=== the 68881 on a 68000
 .arch 68000,68881
 fmovex %fp0,%fp1
 fmovemx %fp0-%fp3,%sp@-
 fbne .
 fjeq ext
 faddx %a0@(8,%d1:w),%fp2
